page.overview:
What is Milky Road?

Milky Roads (literally translated as "River of Clouds") are artificial routes in Skypiea, manufactured from clouds. One leads from the Heaven's Gate up to the White-White Sea.

Another connects Angel Island to the Upper Yard and then flows along the whole Upper Yard. People travel through the Milky Roads like through a river, usually using Dial-powered vessels. Milky Dials are also capable of fashioning Milky Roads, which the White Berets use to subdue criminals.

After the timeskip, Nami is able to create these using her Sorcery Clima-Tact.
